name: AnveVoice — Voice AI for Your Website
author: Adarsh Kant

sections.description:
AnveVoice is the easiest way to add a powerful AI voice assistant to any WordPress website. Your visitors simply speak — and AnveVoice listens, understands, and takes real actions on your behalf.

Whether you’re running a business website, an online store, a healthcare practice, or an agency — AnveVoice turns every visitor into a conversation and every conversation into a result.

Setup takes less than 5 minutes. No coding. No developer needed.

Why AnveVoice?

Most chatbots just answer questions. AnveVoice goes further — it speaks, understands natural language in 50+ languages, navigates your site, fills forms, books appointments, captures leads, and gets things done. All through voice.

What AnveVoice Can Do

  • 🎙️ Natural Voice Conversations — Visitors speak naturally; no typing required
  • ⚡ Takes Real Actions — Fills forms, clicks buttons, navigates pages autonomously
  • 📅 Books Appointments — Schedules meetings and demos in real-time
  • 🌍 50+ Languages — Works with visitors from anywhere in the world
  • 📊 Built-in Analytics — Track sessions, messages, completion rates, and more
  • 🔒 Secure & Reliable — Enterprise-grade infrastructure with 99.9% uptime
  • 🛠️ Developer API & MCP — Powerful APIs for deeper integrations and automation
  • 🎨 Fully Customizable — Match your brand with themes, positions, and personas

Perfect For

  • Businesses — Answer FAQs, capture leads, and guide visitors 24/7
  • E-commerce — Help customers find products, answer questions, and complete purchases
  • Healthcare — Let patients book appointments and get answers instantly
  • Education — Guide students through enrollment, FAQs, and course information
  • Agencies — Deploy voice AI across all your client websites from one dashboard

How It Works

  1. Install and activate the AnveVoice plugin
  2. Sign up for free at app.anvevoice.app
  3. Create your bot from the Anve section in the dashboard
  4. Copy your unique Embed ID from the bot’s Embed tab
  5. Paste it into the AnveVoice plugin settings on your WordPress site
  6. Your AI voice agent is live — visitors can start talking immediately

Agentic Actions That Get Things Done

AnveVoice doesn’t just chat — it acts. Configure which actions your AI can perform:

  • Read Page — Understands and references your page content
  • Scroll — Scrolls to find and highlight relevant content
  • Click — Clicks buttons and links on behalf of the visitor
  • Fill Forms — Fills in lead capture and contact forms automatically
  • Navigate — Moves visitors to the right page instantly
  • Toggle — Interacts with checkboxes, switches, and UI controls

Built-in Analytics Dashboard

Know exactly how your voice AI is performing:

  • Total sessions and messages
  • Average conversation duration
  • Tool call success rates
  • Token usage and cost breakdown
  • Session trends and conversation insights
  • Export reports for your team

Developer First

AnveVoice is built for developers too:

  • Voice API — Real-time voice interaction over TTS / STT / Live
  • MCP (Automation) — Connect your tools and automate workflows seamlessly
  • Live API — Low-latency, production-ready endpoints
  • Webhooks — Trigger your own workflows from voice interactions

Privacy & Data

AnveVoice processes voice input to generate responses. No personal data is stored without user consent. All data is handled in accordance with GDPR guidelines. See our Privacy Policy for full details.
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

  1. Go to your WordPress dashboard → Plugins → Add New
  2. Search for AnveVoice
  3. Click Install Now and then Activate
  4. Go to Dashboard → AnveVoice and enter your Embed ID

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin zip file
  2. Go to Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin
  3. Upload the zip and click Install Now
  4. Activate the plugin
  5. Go to Dashboard → AnveVoice and enter your Embed ID

Getting Your Embed ID

  1. Sign up for free at app.anvevoice.app
  2. Go to the Anve section and create a new bot
  3. Configure your bot — name, persona, knowledge base, and tools
  4. Go to the Embed tab and copy your unique Embed ID
  5. Paste it into the AnveVoice plugin settings on your WordPress site
sections.faq:
Is AnveVoice free to use?

AnveVoice offers a free plan to get started. Paid plans are available for higher usage, advanced features, and team access. Visit app.anvevoice.app for full pricing details.

Do I need coding skills to set it up?

Not at all. Installation takes less than 5 minutes — just install the plugin, create a bot on the Anve dashboard, and paste your Embed ID. No coding required.

Which languages does AnveVoice support?

AnveVoice supports 50+ languages including English, Hindi, Spanish, French, German, Arabic, Portuguese, and many more.

Will it slow down my website?

No. The AnveVoice widget loads asynchronously and does not affect your page load time or Core Web Vitals.

Can I customize the look and feel of the widget?

Yes. You can customize the widget theme (light/dark), position (bottom-left, bottom-right), welcome message, voice, and persona from your Anve dashboard.

Does it work with WooCommerce?

Yes. AnveVoice works on any WordPress page including WooCommerce product pages, checkout pages, and shop pages.

Can AnveVoice fill forms and book appointments?

Yes. AnveVoice can autonomously fill forms, click buttons, navigate pages, and complete real actions on your website — not just answer questions.

Is my data secure?

Yes. AnveVoice uses enterprise-grade security with encrypted data transmission. We are GDPR compliant and never sell user data.

What happens if a visitor asks something the bot doesn’t know?

The bot will politely let the visitor know it doesn’t have that information and can guide them to the right contact or resource.
